maxRenderDistance.desc:: Maximum allowed render distance, changes require a game restart. default 64

chunkPreview.descEnable:: Enables chunk preview feature, which enables saving and loading previously visited chunks to/from disk, default true
chunkPreview.descSpeed:: Set the speed at which chunk preview loads chunks from disk, default and minimum 1 Chunk per tick(20 per second)

debugLogging.desc:: Enables debug logging to latest.log, default false
